messages:
maya.p: Quick context — Orchid Payments wants a 2-week POC. Primary workload is real-time chat moderation + payment confirmation LLM (llama-3-70b). Target SLA: p95 token latency < 300ms, support ~6 concurrent interactive sessions with ~1k token context. Need dedicated pool in us-east-1; they prefer H100 if available. What's the recommended SKU + reservation size? Thanks!

samir.r: Thanks — a couple clarifying q's: 1) model flavor + quantization (fp16 vs 8bit)? 2) avg / peak requests per sec per session? 3) burst tolerance & do they want autoscale?

maya.p: Model is locked to Llama-3 70B FP16 for quality (no 8-bit). Typical interactive session: ~1 req every 1.5s avg, peaks ~4 req/s across all sessions. Max generation length ~512 tokens. They want minimal cold-starts.

samir.r: Ok. Rough calc: for L3-70B FP16 on h100-80gb, at seq 512 we'd expect ~6-8 tokens/s per GPU in streaming mode. With our KV-cache and continuous batching, realistic concurrent interactive sessions per GPU ~4. To reliably support 6 concurrent sessions, reserve 2 H100s baseline, but recommend 3 (preferred) or 4 for headroom; autoscale up to 6. If they insist on A100-40GB we'd need 3-4x the count. Want a proposed pool config?

maya.p: Yes please. Also include a cost ballpark and provisioning ETA. They asked if we can pre-warm KV caches.

samir.r: Draft pool config below (for hosted dedicated):

```json
{
  "sku": "h100-80gb-v2",
  "region": "us-east-1",
  "min_instances": 2,
  "max_instances": 6,
  "reserved_capacity": 3,
  "autoscale_policy": "latency_based",
  "target_p95_latency_ms": "300",
  "model": "llama-3-70b-fp16",
  "prewarm_kv_cache": true
}
```

samir.r: Cost ballpark (very rough): reserved 3 x H100-80GB ~ $45k/month committed; 2-week POC (short commit / trial pricing) ~ $8k-$12k one-off depending on usage. We can put them on a short-term reserved plan or credits for the POC — sales to confirm.

elena_ops: @maya.p @samir.r I can provision a POC pool. Need customer org id + billing contact. If they want Private/VPC we need CIDR and peering details. For hosted dedicated we just need org id and authorizing approver. ETA: ~4-6 hours after approval. I will open a ticket.

provisioning-bot: Created ticket POC-9831. Owner: elena_ops. Status: pending-approval. ETA: 4h. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/POC-9831 

alex_eng: One engineering note — to hit p95 <300ms enable prefix caching + set batch_size cap=8 and kv-cache prewarm on model startup. Also set model max_input_tokens to 1024 to avoid excessive KV growth.

maya.p: Sending org id now: ORCH-752. No VPC; hosted dedicated is fine. Can we pre-authorize API keys for their engineers?

elena_ops: Yep — add the developer emails to the ticket and we'll create scoped API keys tied to the pool.

maya.p: Great, thanks all. I'll update customer and loop back with approval. :thumbsup:
